findings.detail: Authenticated key17/36/50/51 control frames use request.len as parser ceiling and Session::frame_limit returns configured transport maximum after proof; with transport cap larger than Limits.frame_bytes, declared one-control payload ceiling is bypassed. API18 separately enforces its frame_bytes. Transport still bounds allocation. Enforce control payload length before parse/work, regress authentic postauth socket with wider transport cap, and distinguish admitted buffer cap from control parser cap.

reviewed_invariants: TLS and SASL absolute deadlines start at accepted socket admission; TLS uses minimum handshake/preauth deadline; handler-permit wait, response writes and reads retain absolute limits.
Preauth cumulative wire bytes, rounds, strict message consumption, per-field/count/tag bounds prevent application dispatch before proof; owned profile allowlist selects actually composed ranges.
PLAIN offered only explicit TLS profile; plaintext profile supports SCRAM only; terminal negotiation/proof failures close; v1/v2 lifetime zero and no reauthentication.
Original authentication/Alter wire frames and SaltedPassword copies have zeroizing ownership; errors and Debug remain redacted; private credential service cannot be externally mutated.

Durable Store validates salt/iterations/hash sizes, preserves verifier-only records, poisons ambiguous append failures, skips canceled queued commands, and does not acknowledge nondurable state as success.

Actual Apache Describe duplicate names collapse to one92 result and any repeated Alter username has92 whole-user result, including cross-algorithm changes; authenticated admin allowlist empty by default.
Joined shutdown cancels socket/TLS/auth futures and drains owned connection tasks; feature optionality retains existing unauthenticated listener behavior.
limitations: No listener readiness or full Kafka server/KIP368 claim.
Control-frame enforcement finding must be resolved before final independent live qualification.
Credential identity generations describe immutable snapshots within the process; no durable cross-restart generation monotonicity claimed.
